root_cause: Sync used get_page_by_path($slug) for page adoption. For hierarchical child pages this expects the full hierarchical path, so existing child pages found by the dry-run's slug lookup were missed during sync and recreated. WordPress then changed colliding slugs, causing readback failure.

fix.change: Page slug lookup now uses bounded get_posts with post_name__in=[slug], mirroring the dry-run's global leaf-slug lookup; >1 match remains fail-closed.

next_action: Let the current rollback reach terminal ROLLED_BACK first. Then install V1.13.2, run one fresh read-only final Delta-Dry-Run, verify 355 CREATE + 75 ADOPT (or equivalent if live state changed), then run exactly one final sync.
